[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592707/157ad990740aed07cd35360a8dbd4878e214ef16.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Major Update with New Story Missions & New Maps!
[*] New Recipes Addition.
[*] Few updates on the security system.
[/list]

[h3]Skill Adjustments.[/h3]
[b]Draconic Charge[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the base damage when it is activated after charging.
[*] Increased the skill's second hit damage boost from 0 to a max of 300.
[/list]

[b]Infinite Dimension[/b]
[list]
[*] AGI now affects power.
[/list]

[b]Almighty Wield[/b]
[list]
[*] When taking damage, Godspeed Wield used to only lose its effect by one stage, however, due to the active effect added in a later update, it had become almost meaningless. Therefore, the skill's effect has been revised.
Now you may gain invincibility (based on AGI) when taking damage. This effect may trigger once every 10 seconds.
A passive effect that boosts the physical damage of Halberd skills has also been added.
[/list]

[b]Lunar Misfortune[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved power boost by DEX.
[/list]

[b]Twin Buster Blade[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a guaranteed critical hit effect to the second hit of the AoE attack.
[/list]

[b]Sting Blade[/b]
[list]
[*] When using dual swords, the attack recovery of the second hit can now be canceled with an Evasion.
[/list]

[b]Union Sword[/b]
[list]
[*] Effects that increase the next skill's action speed or allow instant activation now apply to the derived skill. 
[/list]

[h3]The following improvements have been applied.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the effect of heavy armor remodelling.
[/list]

Added the following advantages to body armor that has been remodeled to heavy.
[list]
[*] Flinch resistance +100%
[*] Stun duration -1 second
[*] Fractional Damage reduction (depending on refinement value)
[*] Knock Back distance -50%
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added a special ability to dropped items.
[/list]

[h3]The following issues have been fixed.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Under certain conditions, UI display problem occurs.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Notes[/h3]
* If you cannot start the game, please add the game to the exclusion list of your security software.
For details on how to add it to the exclusion list, please refer to the website of the security software you are using.

[list]

Example:

[4P Party] + [Secondary Party A (2P)] + [Secondary Party B (2P)].

NOTE
*Raid Battle is available after completing Story Mission: "Chaotic Truth".
*When another party is joining in the battle, all the party members' HP will show up on the left of the screen as "Secondary Party".
*When another party becomes unable to join the battle after the battle begins, NPC will automatically join as "Secondary Party".
*The result rewards such as Attacker and Breaker will be defined in each party.
*Skills that affect party members such as Support Skill: "High Cycle" and Shield Skill: "Guardian" affect only the members in your party during raid battles.
On the other hand, skills that choose a target such as Support Skill: "Heal" and "Recovery" are available on players in another party.

The skills below have been adjusted.

[b]Tenryu Ransei[/b]
It has been adjusted so that proration won't happen when using it consecutively.

[b]Garyou Tensei[/b]
"Bouncing Blade" and "Nukiuchi Sennosen" will now accumulate Garyou Tensei's buff.
Added the effect that increases the final damage of Mononofu skills to Garyou Tensei's buff.
If the damage reduction buff from the activation of Garyou Tensei is active, the final damage increase of Mononofu skills will remain at its maximum effect regardless of the current value.

[b]Kasumisetsu Getsuka[/b]
The power has been raised.
The power of the derivative skill "Tenryu Ransei: Zanyu" has been raised.

[b]Dauntless[/b]
The point count will go down by a certain percentage when fighting a field boss.
The count will continue to go down when not fighting the boss.
Added the effect that increases the power of "Tenryu Ransei" from 50 Dauntless points.

[b]Vanquisher[/b]
Shooting range increased to 8m.
Due to this change, the equipment properties "Close Range Power" and "Long Range Power" have been adjusted to refer to the higher value.

[b]Flash Blink[/b]
Changed to normal proration.

[b]Geyser Kick[/b]
Adjusted to give physical penetration bonus regardless of activation distance.

[b]Shield Repair[/b]
Shortened the charging time.

[b]Belagerung[/b]
The power of each attack has been increased and the duration of the debuff has been extended.

[b]Advanced Familia[/b]
Adjusted the time and level for familiar to act unpredictably.
Added a passive effect that increases the power of "Lightning", "Blizzard", and "Meteor Strike"according to the level acquired.

[b]Homing Shot[/b]
Adjusted the number of shots according to the level acquired.

[b]Multiple Hunt/Triple Ace Shots[/b]
Adjusted so that the buff effect will be activated just by using the skill.

[b]Multiple Hunt/Sharp Sniper[/b]
Added DEX boost to the power of the skills.
